verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Pro plan's rule-based automation that imports, merges and categorizes bank transactions, plus role-based access for an accountant or bookkeeper to review the books and reports. That covers only a sliver of transaction matching. Nothing shows an AI agent, exception flagging, a month-end close workflow, or a documented API/MCP surface that an external agent could drive; the developer portal was uncrawlable and the marketing pages document none. Missing for 10: an agent-driven reconciliation workflow, exception detection and flagging, month-end close preparation and sign-off, a programmatic API/MCP access path for agents, and independent corroboration.
